title: issue.status_changed
description: The status of an issue changed: by a person or agent (`updateIssue`), by the regression check (`regressed`), or when a fix was published. `node_id` of the entry is the issue node. The regression check (`regressed`) has the app as actor. **Actor of platform actions** (decision 0006, review R14): when the platform acts on its own, the actor is the app (`{kind: app, id: <app node ID>}`), `on_behalf_of` is null, and the reason is in `data`. This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `issue.status_changed`. Step 3, planned (decision 0004-21, docs/STEP3.md).
